source_trace: The saved skin reminder describes both individual MHR weight admission and the public shared reduction. The existing owners ADLER-L11-MHR-SKIN-WEIGHT-ADMISSION and ADLER-L11-RIG-INFLUENCE-NORMALIZATION address these distinct boundaries; their connection is an explicit overlap in this reminder, not proof all other aliases are resolved.

The earlier isolated pinned MHR release probe found finite nonnegative normalized rows for the three tested rigs. The separately constructed zero-row GLB passed its fixture loader and yielded NaN in shared reduction. Neither result resolves arbitrary-input support or policy for an unweighted vertex.

The selected-source armor blend probe confirmed a zero-share fallback can preserve an all-zero first skin and that a NaN weight survives multiplication by zero in its tested host context. The fitted armor source path connects body weights to flexible armor but has not been exercised end to end with malformed inputs.

The provisional repair order remains MHR numeric admission, shared reduction and fixture policy, corrective data admission, then garment and equipment consumers; these repairs remain gated on completion of the full audit ledger.
remaining_evidence: Decide supported unweighted representation and failure semantics from connected consumers, reconcile all aliases and lenses, and validate integration after implementation.
